statement: Under the ordinary grand-canonical DLR specification with finite activity z>0, finite beta>0, nonnegative pair potential, zero empty energy and no background or count constraint, every bounded B has conditional void probability at least exp(-z|B|). For disjoint equal-volume sets B_i of volume V, P(all N_{B_i}>0)<= (1-exp(-zV))^m. Consequently configurations have arbitrarily large holes and cannot be a uniformly bounded displacement of any full-rank lattice.
assumptions: no neutralizing background, negative external energy, or fixed local count

The density-one simple cubic configuration is force balanced but some finitely supported arbitrarily small displacements strictly lower its relative Riesz energy.
